svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Evaporator ring: a closed rectangle 195 x 130 mm on the tube centre line,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: corners bent to 25 mm radius, ends joined with a coupler, brazed.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two tees in the cooling-end run, 25 mm each side of the centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Risers: from each tee straight up 63.5 mm, then a 90 degree bend of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 17.5 mm radius (lever bender for 8 mm tube) toward the cooling end;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the tail ends 33 mm beyond the outside of the can.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Braze with silver alloy, nitrogen purge; clean and cap the open ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the ring lies in the bottom inside corner of the can, touching

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: floor and wall, bonded with thermally conductive epoxy; the risers

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drop down the can's open slots; the tails go into the cold block.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A refrigeration technician leak tests, evacuates and charges the loop.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the ring lies flat on a table within 1 mm.
